about: CI cost manifest (ci-spend law, 2026-10-11). One entry per workflow, one leg per runner OS. scripts/check_workflow_runner_cost.py fails a workflow or OS leg without an entry, an entry without a benefit, triggers/crons/jobs that differ from the workflow file, and $ that do not add up as warnings; only an undeclared paid runner fails. Spend is judged by the server spend watch (weekly total of real money vs $100), never per repo here.
prices_source: GitHub billing API pricePerUnit (Actions Linux / Windows / macOS 3-core), read 2026-10-11

ci-cd.yml.benefit: Builds the ship images and deploys production/staging on push.
ci-cd.yml.owner_reason: This repo ships itself on push to main.
ci-cd.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): 164/week x 14.2 min, + ~1 min ci-cost-guard job

deploy-instance.yml.benefit: Deploys one named ship instance on demand.
